entities.name: Irbit State Motorcycle Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Irbit State Motorcycle Museum is a museum in Irbit, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russia. The museum was created as a State Museum of the Russian Federation to protect the former IMZ Factory Museum from sale and dispersal.
